subject: aiml
overview: Learn AI and Machine Learning from foundational concepts through advanced techniques. Build theoretical understanding of intelligent systems, machine learning algorithms, and their practical applications in real-world scenarios.

beginner.name: Beginner
beginner.prerequisites: Basic programming concepts and familiarity with mathematics
beginner.outcomes: Strong foundational knowledge in AI/ML concepts and terminology

intermediate.name: Intermediate
intermediate.description: Application level - Apply concepts to solve problems
intermediate.prerequisites: Completion of all beginner modules with 75%+ average
intermediate.outcomes: Ability to understand and apply core machine learning algorithms

advanced.name: Advanced
modules: Limitations and Ethical Issues in AI
advanced.prerequisites: Completion of all intermediate modules with 75%+ average
advanced.outcomes: Professional-level expertise in ML model evaluation, optimization, and understanding of AI applications and ethics

progression_logic: Students must complete all modules in a level with an average quiz score of 75% or higher before advancing to the next level. Each module quiz must be passed with at least 75% to proceed to the next module within the same level.
